translations.text: And the king spoke to me about this. I pleaded and prayed before the God of heaven.
And I said to them, “You see the trouble we are in: Jerusalem is in ruins, and its gates are burned with fire. Come, let us rebuild Jerusalem’s wall, so that we will no longer be a disgrace.”
Jedaiah son of Harumaph and the head of his household strengthened the adjoining section, and Hattush son of Hashabneiah strengthened the adjoining section.
Then, when our enemies heard that the matter had become known to us and that the Lord had nullified their promises, we all returned and went up to the wall, and each of us worked at his own task.
Then the people and their wives raised a loud outcry against their fellow Jews.
For he was hired so that I would become afraid, act in this way, and sin, and so that they would have grounds to give me a bad name and reproach me.
Those who came up with Zerubbabel were Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nehemiael, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, and Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:
The descendants of Pahath-moab, belonging to the descendants of Jeshua and Joab: 2,818.
The descendants of Jericho: three hundred and forty-five.
The Levites, the descendants of Jeshua belonging to Kadmiel, of the descendants of Hodiah: 74.
The ministers, the descendants of Asaph: 148.
These came up from Tel-melah to Tel-abba and Cherub. They spoke, but could not show their ancestral families or their lineage, except that they were from Israel.

Nehemiah, the chief of the priests, Ezra the priest and scribe, and the Levites who were ministering to the people spoke to all the people, saying, “Today is holy before the Lord your God. Do not grieve or weep.” For all the people were weeping as they heard the book of the law.
You saw the enslavement of our ancestors in Egypt and heard their outcry at the Red Sea.
You split the sea before them, and they crossed through the sea on dry ground. You drowned their pursuers in the depths of the sea, as a stone sinks in mighty waters.

In your great mercy you did not abandon them in the wilderness. The pillar of cloud did not depart from them by day, guiding them along the way, nor did the pillar of fire by night, lighting the path they were to take.
You made their children as numerous as the stars in heaven and brought them into the land that you had told their ancestors to enter and possess.

The rest of the people—the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the ministers, the servants, and everyone who had separated themselves from the peoples of the lands—are to come to the law of the Lord, together with their wives, their sons, their daughters, and everyone who knows and understands.
We imposed on ourselves the obligation to give a third of a stater each week for the service of the house of our God.
Maaseiah son of Baruch, son of Col-hozeh, son of Adaiah, son of Azariah, son of Jonadab, son of Zechariah, son of Shelah.
All the descendants of Perez who lived in Jerusalem numbered 468 valiant men.
Joel son of Zechariah was in charge of them, and Judah son of Senuah was in charge of the city’s second quarter.
Their relatives, heads of their ancestral households, numbered 242; and Amashai son of Azarel, son of Ahzai, son of Meshillemoth, son of Immer.
All the Levites in the holy city numbered 284.
Jeshua fathered Joiakim, Joiakim fathered Eliashib, and Eliashib fathered Joiada.
These were in the days of Joiakim son of Jeshua, son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiael the leader and Ezra the priest and scribe.

And his brothers Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, [?], Nethanel, Hanani, and Judah, with the musical instruments of David, the prophet and servant of the Lord; and Ezra the scribe went before them.
They kept watch in the house of their God and carried out their duties in purity, as did the ministers and gatekeepers, according to the command of David and his son Solomon.
I was greatly displeased, and I threw all the furnishings of Tobiah’s house into the street, outside the courtyard.
Remember me, my God, for this, and do not erase the good deeds I have done in the house of my God and in carrying out its duties.

I told the Levites to purify themselves and come in as guards and gatekeepers to keep the Sabbath day holy. Remember me for this also, my God, and have compassion on me according to your abundant mercy.
